name: SaintDeer's Tactical Accessories Integration (SDTAC KITS)
teaser: A bunch of additional attachments for a wide variety of weapons!
description_html:
THIS IS NOT MY MOD!

This is an update and reupload of SaintDeer’s Tactical Accessories Integration. I do not and will not take credit for modding these items into our favorite Russian purgatory. I simply updated the IDs present in the 3.9 release. I will not provide content updates, but rather spt version updates and bug fixes if needed.

This mod adds:

3 high capacity magazines

2 rail risers for optics

6 stocks

1 PKP/PKM buffer tube adapter

1 PKP/PKM picatinny mount for optics

1 PKP/PKM Zenit B-50 upper rail segment

3 Aug handguards

2 Kriss Vector barrels (1 for each caliber)

2 Kriss Vector handguards

1 MP7 extended rail/barrel combo (carbine extension)

1 AK-12 handguard (my favorite)

2 P90 receiver thingies

1 P90 stock

1 P90 stock butt pad

2 modernized PPSH-41 parts

And maybe other stuff if I forgot!

I asked SaintDeer for permission to upload this mod. If for whatever reason I receive a request or demand to remove this mod from either SaintDeer or the SPT administrators I will fulfill it.
